privacy_intro: This showcase requires no account and sells nothing directly: data collection is minimal.

privacy_sections.p: Anonymous visit counter: each page view increments a daily counter, with no identifier or IP address stored. Anonymous click counter: clicks to external platforms (Payhip, Gumroad, Shopify, Google Play) are counted in aggregate. There is no user account on this site.

Language cookie: remembers your language choice (French, English, Haitian Creole, Spanish). Technical session cookie: used only for the admin area. Local storage: remembers your visual theme choice, only on your device.
Counters are used solely to measure site traffic, internally. No profiling, no targeted advertising.
No data is sold or shared with third parties.
Buttons to purchase or download platforms (Payhip, Gumroad, Shopify, Google Play) redirect you to third-party sites, subject to their own privacy policies.
For any question about this policy, contact Lesly Tech LLC through the channels listed on this site.

Signing in with Google is optional: the whole site stays accessible without an account. If you sign in, we only receive your Google name, e-mail address and profile photo. We then link the pages you view, your clicks to the stores and your questions to the assistant to your account, in order to offer relevant recommendations. We only send you e-mails (news, tips, reminders) if you ticked the consent box; every e-mail includes a one-click unsubscribe link. You can ask us to delete your data at any time via the Contact page.

From your first visit, the site sets its own technical cookie ("ltl_vid", valid for 1 year) containing a random identifier, without your name. It is used to recognize your device on later visits and to keep a history of your visits (pages viewed, date, referrer, device type, approximate country and IP address) and of your chats with the assistant, so we can advise you consistently from one visit to the next and keep the site secure. This data is neither sold nor shared for advertising. Profiles inactive for 13 months are deleted automatically. You can clear this cookie in your browser at any time, or ask us to delete your history via the Contact page.

privacy_sections.h: Offers and promo codes by e-mail
privacy_sections.p: If you leave your e-mail address to receive an offer (and tick the consent box), we use it to send you the promo code and then, at most once a week, offers and news related to the books you viewed. Every e-mail includes a one-click unsubscribe link; your address is never sold or shared. Promo codes are used on the sales platforms (Payhip, Gumroad, Shopify) under their terms.
